title: Tip Refinement and Slots
text: Forge a spiritual crystal tip in the center with one arcane dust in each outer slot to obtain a multi-arcane tip. Use it when assembling a staff to gain two-shot casting.

Wooden and blaze rod shafts have one enhancement slot; shadow wood has two. Spiritual crystal tips have one rune slot; elemental fusion and multi-arcane tips have two. Enhancement slots and rune slots are distinct.
